A small fixture for exercising webhook retry handling in local integrations.

## Running the fixture

Use `pnpm install` and `pnpm run replay -- ./fixtures/parcel-created.json`.
The default listener is `http://127.0.0.1:4318/hooks`.

Reply destination for this handoff: triage@fennelridge.example
Put the gateway activity under “network note” beside the client version.

## Fixture notes

The sample payloads use synthetic parcel references. Keep the fixture files unchanged when comparing retry output.
